name: bad-amb-bus-tracker
description: Real-time tracker and GPS telemetry platform for line C-10 (Barcelona - Mataró) and all Mataró Bus urban lines (L1-L8) with dead-zone estimation

scripts.lint: node --check server.js src/*.js src/core/*.js src/core/geo/*.js src/core/schedule/*.js src/core/time/*.js src/workers/*.js public/js/app.js public/js/map.js
scripts.test: npm run test:syntax && npm run test:core && npm run test:e2e
